UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated device owner profile storing active role and family binding.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

familyId.description: ID of the linked family group.

fcmToken.description: Latest FCM registration token for lightweight data notifications.

deviceModel.description: Manufacturer and model name of the Android device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Family.title: Family
Family.description: Parent-owned family scope for notification mirroring.

name.description: Display name of the family group.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parent who created the family.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FamilyMember.title: FamilyMember
FamilyMember.description: Member entry inside a family defining parent or child permissions and health telemetry.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

displayName.description: Human-readable name of the user or device.

fcmToken.description: FCM token for data-only alert delivery.

listenerActive.description: Whether NotificationListenerService is currently bound and healthy.

companionTrusted.description: Whether CompanionDeviceManager trusted association is active for Android 15+ OTP exemption.

pairedAt.description: Server timestamp when paired via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

NotificationRecord.title: NotificationRecord
NotificationRecord.description: Captured notification payload mirrored from a child device.

childUid.description: Auth UID of the child device that posted this record.

appLabel.description: Normalized app display label (WhatsApp, Messages, Messenger, Telegram).

text.description: Notification EXTRA_TEXT or MessagingStyle concatenated text.

isMessagingStyle.description: True when MessagingStyle messages were extracted.

conversationTitle.description: Group or conversation title from MessagingStyle.

messages.description: Bounded list of extracted MessagingStyle message entries.

dayKey.description: ISO local date yyyy-MM-dd for day grouping.

updateCount.description: Number of updates merged for the same StatusBarNotification.key.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when first created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ListenerAlert.title: ListenerAlert
ListenerAlert.description: Alert pushed by the child watchdog when listener access is revoked or rebound.

childUid.description: Auth UID of the child device.

message.description: Human-readable description of the listener state change.

acknowledged.description: Whether a parent has dismissed or acknowledged the alert.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PairingCode.title: PairingCode
PairingCode.description: Short-lived 6-character code generated by Cloud Functions to link a child device to a family.

createdByUid.description: Parent UID who requested the code.

used.description: Whether the code has been redeemed.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private profile and persisted device role binding.

/families/{familyId}.description: Top-level family container owned by a parent account.

/families/{familyId}/members/{memberUid}.description: Family members subcollection enforcing parent read vs child write roles.

/families/{familyId}/notifications/{reco.description: Mirrored notification records scoped by familyId.

/families/{familyId}/alerts/{alertId}.description: Listener revocation and watchdog health alerts scoped by familyId.
